splash.heading: Welcome to Middle-earth
splash.intro: An interactive map of Tolkien’s Middle-earth, with events from across the legendarium plotted as markers.
splash.tip1: Click markers to read about key events
splash.tip2: Use the Legend panel to filter by book or toggle journey paths
splash.tip3: Enable “Measure distance” in the Legend to measure between two points
splash.tip4Html: Hit Play the story to watch all 128 events unfold in order
splash.disclaimer: The base map image is sourced from the internet and is used here for fan/educational purposes. We do not claim copyright over the map artwork.

map.toast: Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Click markers for details
map.copyright: Map artwork is not owned by this project and is used for fan/educational purposes only.

head.mapTitle: Interactive Middle-earth Map — LOTR, Hobbit & Silmarillion
head.mapDescription: An interactive map of Middle-earth: 128 events from The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit and The Silmarillion, with journey paths and a satellite view.
head.timelineDescription: A chronological timeline of Middle-earth: events from The Silmarillion through The Lord of the Rings, with playback controls and category filters.
